title: Concept: jQuery parseHTML of untrusted markup
description: A jQuery parseHTML call in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: parseHTML turns a string into DOM nodes without the page's sanitiser, and the nodes then get inserted wherever the caller chooses.
applicability: Deployments that render a jQuery parseHTML call into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: parseHTML turns a string into DOM nodes without the page's sanitiser, and the nodes then get inserted wherever the caller chooses.
